name: archive.verify
description: Weekly: re-hashes every archived bundle against its manifest and announces one that no longer verifies (event archive.verification_failed).

name: artifacts.cleanup
description: Deletes generated documents (Certificate of Analysis PDFs) after their 30-day retention.

name: audit.anchor
description: Daily anchor of the audit trail head to the second path (AUDIT_ANCHOR_DIR or the backup mirror), then a check of every anchor against the database.

name: audit.clock
description: Clock guard: a clock found earlier than records already written blocks signing until an Administrator acknowledges it.

name: audit.verify
description: Weekly check of the whole audit hash chain and of the security event chain; the result is a security event.

name: backup.daily
description: Encrypted backup, copied to the mirror, then pruned by the 7/4/12 retention rule.

name: backup.drill
description: Monthly restore drill: the newest backup is restored into a scratch database and compared with its manifest.

name: calibration.due
description: Daily: announces instruments due for calibration within 30 days, and overdue ones (event instrument.calibration_due).

name: em.trends
description: Daily: environmental monitoring adverse trends (3 consecutive alert-level results at a point, 2 action-level results within 30 days, a recurring organism in a room).

name: oot.evaluate
description: Hourly: approved results are checked against the control-limit baselines; a rule violation raises an advisory out-of-trend alert (no result or disposition is changed).

name: periodic.scan
description: Daily: opens the periodic reviews that fall due within 14 days and announces open reviews due or overdue (event periodic.review_due).

name: reagents.expiry
description: Hourly: marks reagent lots and prepared solutions past their expiry (or in-use expiry) Expired, and announces those expiring within 30 and 7 days (event reagent.expiry_alert).

name: stability.timepoints
description: Hourly: stability pulls whose window opened become Due; a window that closed without a pull becomes Missed and opens a deviation; pulled timepoints follow their sample (InTesting, Complete).

name: tat.sweep
description: Every 10 minutes: starts the turnaround clock of received samples (due date from the priority and the business calendar), and announces samples due within 24 hours and overdue ones (event sample.tat_alert).

name: training.overdue
description: Daily: assigns curricula to users and documents added since, marks training past its due date Overdue and re-derives the software-trained flag.
